```{r}
library(tidyverse)

load('Data/preprocessed_data_min_occs_is_5_coverage_is_good_and_average.RData')
head(Design)
head(Tr)
head(Y[,1:5])
threshold <- 0.1


# 1. Calculate Occupancy per species per Atlas period
# We use colMeans grouped by the 'atlas' column in Design
occ_summary <- as.data.frame(Y) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = 'survey') %>% 
  left_join(Design %>% rownames_to_column('survey'), by = 'survey') %>% 
  relocate(c('survey','atlas','site')) %>% 
  select(-survey, -site, -lat, -lon, -year) %>% # Ensure only species and atlas remain
  group_by(atlas) %>%
  # Calculate both mean (occupancy) and sum (total count)
  summarise(across(everything(), list(occ = \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                      count = \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
  # Pivot into a long format to handle the two different metrics
  pivot_longer(cols = -atlas, 
               names_to = c("species", ".value"), 
               names_sep = "_(?!.*_)") %>% # Regex to split at the last underscore
  # Pivot wider to get the Atlas periods as columns
  pivot_wider(names_from = atlas, 
              values_from = c(occ, count),
              names_glue = "{.value}_atlas{atlas}") %>% 
  mutate(
    # Change from Atlas 1 to 2
    changea12 = case_when(
      (occ_atlas2 - occ_atlas1) / occ_atlas1 <= -threshold ~ "decrease",
      (occ_atlas2 - occ_atlas1) / occ_atlas1 >=  threshold ~ "increase",
      TRUE ~ "stable"
    ),
    # Change from Atlas 2 to 3
    changea23 = case_when(
      (occ_atlas3 - occ_atlas2) / occ_atlas2 <= -threshold ~ "decrease",
      (occ_atlas3 - occ_atlas2) / occ_atlas2 >=  threshold ~ "increase",
      TRUE ~ "stable"
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Create the overall trajectory column
    overall_trajectory = case_when(
      changea12 == "increase" & changea23 == "increase" ~ "increase",

      changea12 == "decrease" & changea23 == "decrease" ~ "decrease",

      
      changea12 == "stable" & changea23 == "stable" ~ "stable",
      TRUE ~ "fluctuating"
    )
  ) %>% 
  left_join(.,Tr %>% 
              rownames_to_column(.,var='species'),
            by = 'species') %>% 
  relocate(c('species','Migration_a3_DOF','foraging_guild_consensus','species_thermal_index'))

traits <- occ_summary %>%
  mutate(habitat_class = case_when(
    # WETLAND
    foraging_guild_consensus %in% c(

      "Aquatic pursuers", "Scolopacids", "Plovers", "Wading birds", "Rails", 
      "Marsh warblers", "Marsh wablers", "Dippers", "Kingfishers", "Reedlings"
    ) ~ "Wetland",
    # MARINE
    foraging_guild_consensus %in% c(
      "Terns", "Gulls"
    ) ~ "Marine",
    # OPEN-LAND
    foraging_guild_consensus %in% c(
      "Gallinaceous birds", "Passerine seedeaters", "Open-land insectivores", 
      "Buntings", "Shrikes", "Hoopoes", "Beeeaters"
    ) ~ "Open-land",
    # FOREST
    foraging_guild_consensus %in% c(
      "Foliage gleaners", "Woodpeckers", "Orioles", "Thrushes", 
      "Cuckoos", "Tit-like birds", "Owls"
    ) ~ "Forest",
    # URBAN / GENERALIST (Species that bridge many habitats)
    foraging_guild_consensus %in% c(
      "Diurnal raptors", "Aerial insectivores", "Nigthjars", 
      "Low flycatching feeders", "Omnivorous corvids", 
      "Flycatchers", "Starlings", "Columbids"
    ) ~ "Generalist/Urban"
  ))

data <- occ_summary
head(occ_summary)
plot_bird_trends <- function(data, group_col, min_species = 3, sort_type = "decline", merge_periods = FALSE) {
  
  # 1. Initial Cleaning & Filtering
  df_clean <- data %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    mutate(n_species = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(n_species >= min_species) %>%
    mutate(group_label = paste0({{ group_col }}, " (n=", n_species, ")"))
  
  if (merge_periods) {
    # --- MODE: MERGED PERIODS (Overall Trajectory) ---
    processed_data <- df_clean %>%
      mutate(trend_display = case_when(
        overall_trajectory == "decrease"    ~ "Declining (--)",

        overall_trajectory == "increase"    ~ "Increasing (++)",


        overall_trajectory == "stable"      ~ "Stable (==)",
        overall_trajectory == "fluctuating" ~ "Fluctuating (mix)"
      )) %>%
      # Ensure logical order in the legend
      mutate(trend_display = fct_relevel(factor(trend_display), 
                                         "Declining (--)",
                                         "Fluctuating (mix)", 
                                         "Stable (==)",
                                         "Increasing (++)")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(trend_display)) %>%
      select(group_label, trend_display)
    
    fill_colors <- c("Declining (--)"    = "#e41a1c", 
                     "Fluctuating (mix)" = "#ff7f00", 
                     "Stable (==)"       = "#999999", 
                     "Increasing (++)"   = "#4daf4a")
    facet_logic <- NULL
    
  } else {
    # --- MODE: TIMELINE (Side-by-side) ---
    processed_data <- df_clean %>%
      select(group_label, changea12, changea23) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(changea12, changea23),
                   names_to = "period", values_to = "trend_display") %>%
      mutate(
        period = if_else(period == "changea12", "Period 1 (a1-a2)", "Period 2 (a2-a3)"),
        # Use your new labels: "-", "stable", "+"
        trend_display = fct_relevel(factor(trend_display), "decrease", "stable", "increase")
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(trend_display))
    
    fill_colors <- c("decrease" = "#e41a1c", "stable" = "#999999", "increase" = "#4daf4a")
    facet_logic <- facet_wrap(~ period)
  }
  
  # 2. Calculate Sorting & Labels
  plot_ready <- processed_data %>%
    group_by(group_label, across(any_of("period")), trend_display) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
    mutate(prop = count / sum(count),
           label = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Dynamic Sorting Logic
  if (sort_type == "decline") {
    sort_scores <- plot_ready %>%
      filter(trend_display %in% c("Declining (--)", "decrease")) %>%
      group_by(group_label) %>%
      summarise(score = sum(prop), .groups = "drop")
  } else if (sort_type == "increase") {
    sort_scores <- plot_ready %>%
      filter(trend_display %in% c("Increasing (++)", "increase")) %>%
      group_by(group_label) %>%
      summarise(score = sum(prop), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    sort_scores <- data.frame(group_label = unique(plot_ready$group_label), score = 1)
  }
  
  plot_ready <- plot_ready %>%
    left_join(sort_scores, by = "group_label") %>%
    mutate(score = replace_na(score, 0)) %>%
    mutate(group_label = fct_reorder(group_label, score))
  
  # 3. Create Plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_ready, aes(y = group_label, x = count, fill = trend_display)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), 
              position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), 
              color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), expand = c(0,0)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Relative Proportion of Species", y = NULL, fill = "Trend",
         title = if(merge_periods) "Overall Trajectory (a1-a3)" else "Temporal Population Trends",
         subtitle = paste("Sorted by:", sort_type, "| Min species per group:", min_species)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  if (!is.null(facet_logic)) p <- p + facet_logic
  return(p)
}

plot_bird_trends(traits, habitat_class, min_species = 1,merge_periods = T,sort_type = 'decline')
plot_bird_trends(traits, foraging_guild_consensus, min_species = 5,merge_periods = F,sort_type = 'decline')

plot_bird_trends(traits, Migration_a3_DOF, min_species = 3,merge_periods = T,sort_type = 'decline')


plot_bird_trends(traits, habitat_class, min_species = 3,merge_periods = T,sort_type = 'decline')
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)

plot_trait_overlap <- function(data, x_var, fill_var, custom_levels = NULL, custom_colors = NULL) {
  
  x_sym <- rlang::sym(x_var)
  fill_sym <- rlang::sym(fill_var)
  
  # 1. Clean data (remove NAs)
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!x_sym), !is.na(!!fill_sym))
  
  # 2. Sort X-axis (Migration Gradient: Long-distance -> Resident)
  if (!is.null(custom_levels)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(!!x_var := factor(!!x_sym, levels = custom_levels))
  } else {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(!!x_var := fct_infreq(as.factor(!!x_sym)))
  }

  # 3. Create the Plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = !!x_sym, fill = !!fill_sym)) +
    # Proportional bars with black outlines for distinctness
    geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Habitat Composition by Migration Strategy"),
      subtitle = "Proportional overlap of habitat classes across migration categories",
      x = "Migration Strategy",
      y = "Proportion of Species (%)",
      fill = "Habitat Class"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 10),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  # 4. Apply Custom Color Scheme
  if (!is.null(custom_colors)) {
    p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors)
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# --- CONFIGURATION ---

# 1. Define the Migration order
mig_order <- c(
  "long-distance migrant",
  "short- and long-distance migrant",
  "short-distance migrant",
  "resident and short-distance migrant",
  "resident"
)

# 2. Define the Semantic Colors for Habitat
habitat_colors <- c(
  "Forest"           = "#2E7D32", # Deep Green
  "Open-land"        = "#F9A825", # Golden Yellow
  "Wetland"          = "#00ACC1", # Cyan/Teal
  "Marine"           = "#1565C0", # Deep Blue
  "Generalist/Urban" = "#6A1B9A", # Purple
  "Other/Unknown"    = "#9E9E9E"  # Grey
)

# --- RUN THE PLOT ---
plot_trait_overlap(
  data = traits, 
  x_var = "Migration_a3_DOF_description", 
  fill_var = "habitat_class", 
  custom_levels = mig_order, 
  custom_colors = habitat_colors
)
```
